title: Don't change people. Change the rules.
hook: Stop trying to change people. Change the rules, and they'll change themselves.
caption: Don't change people, change the rules. One cuts, the other picks first — so the cake gets cut fairly with no referee. That's mechanism design.
cta: Follow QuanTik for the game theory of real life

thumb.footer: Simulated / sourced data • Educational, not advice
headline: CHANGE
THE
RULES.

scenes.say: Stop trying to change people. Change the rules, and they'll change themselves.
Two kids fighting over one cake. There's a rule that makes both feel it's fair.
One cuts. The other picks first. So the cutter cuts as evenly as humanly possible.
No referee, no trust needed. The rule does the work.
Auctions, bonuses, refund policies: all mechanism design.
To change behaviour, don't preach. Change what people win and lose.
scenes.show: Change what they win and lose.

takeaway: To change behaviour, don't preach. Change what people win and lose.
